stacking.note: Stacks over the two 40G QSFP+ ports by default (160 Gbps interconnect) or over the 1/10G SFP+ uplinks (80 Gbps). QSFP+ ports can be reconfigured as network uplinks

routing.summary: Base includes RIP and static routing. OSPF, VRF-lite, and IPv6 routing need an Enhanced Feature or Flex Advanced license. BGP, MBGP, and IS-IS need an Advanced Feature or Flex Premium license

routeScale: 14,000 IPv4 prefixes / 36,000 host routes; 3,500 IPv6 prefixes / 18,000 host routes
macsec: IEEE 802.1AE MACsec (up to 88 Gbps near line-rate on GbE and 10GbE ports)

power.summary: Dual hot-swap AC (or DC) PSU bays; one PSU included. 600W on 24P, 920W on 48P, 150W on non-PoE

redundancy.detail: One PSU included; second sold separately (internal, hot-swap). Fans are field-replaceable

licensing: Juniper Flex: Standard included. OSPF needs Flex Advanced/Premium or legacy EX-24-EFL / EX-48-EFL. BGP needs Flex Premium or the legacy Advanced Feature license. Subscriptions include Mist Wired Assurance
